name: Nifedipine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.effect: Phenytoin lowers nifedipine exposure by about 70% (label).
key_interactions.action: Avoid, or use an alternative antihypertensive.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CYP3A4 inhibitors (fluconazole, itraconazole, clarithromycin, erythromycin, nefazodone, fluoxetine, saquinavir, indinavir, nelfinavir)
key_interactions.action: Monitor and adjust; consider starting nifedipine at the lowest dose.

key_interactions.effect: Digoxin levels may rise (average 45% in one study) (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor digoxin when starting, adjusting or stopping nifedipine.

key_interactions.effect: Usually well tolerated; occasional heart failure, severe hypotension or worse angina reported (label).
Rare reports of higher prothrombin time (label).
